summary.et: Keeratava korgiga õõnes muna väikesele mänguasjale, mis sees loksub.
summary.en: A hollow screw-top egg for a small toy that rattles inside.

story.et: Soma muna keere pikemal munal. Õmblus on kolmandiku kõrgusel, kus valge alus saab kokku punase korgiga ja korgi keerdvoldid algavad, nii et keere jääb peitu. Sees on ruumi 64 mm kõrgusele painduvale loomale, kes mahub läbi 43 mm ava ja loksub vabalt. Sein on igal pool vähemalt 1,6 mm paks ja ükski sisepind ei ulatu prinditult üle 45 kraadi, nii et alus ja kork prinditakse ilma tugedeta, kumbki oma värviga.
story.en: The Soma egg's thread on a longer egg. The seam sits a third of the way up, where the white base meets the red cap and the cap's spiral flutes begin, so the thread stays hidden. Inside there is room for a 64 mm flexible animal, which passes the 43 mm opening and rattles loose. The wall is at least 1.6 mm thick everywhere and no inner surface overhangs more than 45 degrees as printed, so the base and the cap print without supports, each in its own colour.
